name: Plate
tagline: Editorial plates of anything: quotes, explainers, processes, and a project's architecture.

fields.name: brief
fields.note: what the person asked for: for an infographic its subject and what to say; for an architecture the path the numbers walk; never a guess at the architecture

fields.name: sources
fields.note: the folders or files the plate is drawn from, relative to the project

fields.name: spec
fields.note: a plate’s PNG from an earlier call (it carries its spec), to draw again; with a brief, changed as the brief asks

fields.name: output
fields.note: where to write the PNG; docs/README_Assets/<title>.png when the project has that folder

fields.name: rounds
fields.note: how many times to fix what the plate measured; 3 when left out

fields.name: form
fields.note: infographic (quotes, a creative piece, an explanation, a process, figures) or architecture (a project’s flow from its code); left out, code sources are drawn as their architecture and everything else as an infographic
